environment.description: Deployed behind Azure Front Door Premium with a custom security policy applying Microsoft_DefaultRuleSet_2.1 (DRS 2.1) and Microsoft_BotManagerRuleSet_1.0. Additionally, the Front Door instance has a custom rate-limit rule (priority 1) configured as: match condition 'RequestUri contains /api/products/search', rate-limit threshold of 5 requests per 1-minute window per SocketAddr, action Block with 429 response for 60 seconds. The origin is locked to only accept traffic from the Front Door service tag (AzureFrontDoor.Backend) via NSG and the X-Azure-FDID header is validated in the App Service access restrictions. The DRS 2.1 ruleset includes rule group SQLi with rules 942100, 942110, 942120, 942130, 942140, 942150, 942160, 942170, 942180, 942190, 942200, 942210, 942220, 942230, 942240, 942250, 942260, 942270, 942280, 942290, 942300, 942310, 942320, 942330, 942340, 942350, 942360, 942370, 942380, 942390, 942400 all in Block mode with anomaly scoring threshold 5.

config.origin_lock: NSG restricts to AzureFrontDoor.Backend service tag + X-Azure-FDID validation
config.sqli_rules: 942100-942400 series all in Block mode, anomaly threshold 5
